title: Independent spin-localization test for syringol phenoxy radical
difficulty_reasons: The radical and measured sites are fixed, but the agent must independently select and validate an open-shell electronic-structure/population-analysis route.
The result requires interpreting a site ordering while tracking symmetry-equivalent C2/C6 atoms and method dependence.

data.description: Self-contained XYZ for the 20-atom neutral doublet syringol phenoxy radical with explicit atom map in the file comment and task.

required_deliverables.description: Validated method, four site spin populations, ordering, conclusion and bounded-failure fields.
